title: OpenAI's super PAC is funding AI-generated news site attacking industry critics
summary: OpenAI的超级政治行动委员会（super PAC）被曝资助一个由AI机器人撰写文章的新闻网站，该网站发布内容攻击行业批评者，以推进其政治议程。
highlights: OpenAI's super PAC is funding AI-generated news site attacking industry critics
The reporters at this news site are AI bots. OpenAI's super PAC appears to be using it to advance its political agenda
